auth.subtitle: Fast hotel check-in for public authorities
auth.signUpSuccess: Account created — check email if confirmation required
auth.demoHint: No Supabase required. Data stays in your browser.

capture.title: Scan document
capture.hintPortrait: ID back vertical: align white MRZ strip (right) in the blue guide.
capture.hintLandscape: Rotate ID 90° or passport open: MRZ lines in the bottom blue strip.
capture.guidePhotoPortrait: Vertical (natural hold): ID back, white MRZ strip on the right visible.
capture.guidePhotoLandscape: Horizontal: ID rotated 90° or passport — MRZ at bottom.
capture.guidePhotoLight: Even light, no direct flash, sharp focus.
capture.guideCameraFocus: Tap screen on MRZ to focus, then Capture.
capture.guideCameraBurst: MRZ strip first, then full document if needed — single capture.
capture.ocrInitFailed: Could not start the reader. Retry or use manual entry.
capture.successReview: Partial read — verify details in the form
capture.failed: Read failed — retry with more light and MRZ in blue strip
capture.failedPhoto: Photo not read — try vertical (MRZ right) or horizontal (MRZ bottom)
capture.chooserHint: Choose how to register the document. On smartphones we recommend uploading a sharp photo of the ID card.

form.title: Guest details
form.birthMunicipalityMrzHint: Not in MRZ — select municipality of birth (not the residence address on the ID card)
form.documentIssuePlaceHint: For ID card: issuing municipality. For passport: foreign country. Pick from the list.
form.selectFromListHint: Type and pick an option from the menu — typing alone is not enough
form.saveSuccess: Check-in saved — go to Export at end of day for the .txt file
form.reviewBanner: Check highlighted fields — automatic reading may be wrong.

errors.birthCountryRequired: Select country of birth from the list
errors.birthMunicipalityRequired: Select municipality of birth from the list (tap a suggestion)
errors.documentIssuePlaceRequired: Select document issue place from the list

form.noComuneResults: No matches — try fewer letters or check spelling

export.title: Alloggiati export
export.hint: Download the daily .txt file and upload it to the Alloggiati Web portal (168 chars/line, UTF-8)
export.dayEmpty: No guests to export for this date
export.portalHint: Open Alloggiati Web → File menu → upload this .txt → Process → Continue.
export.localStorageNotice: Saved locally in the browser (DB unavailable). Export before switching devices.
export.noGuests: No guests to export. Register arrivals from the Check-in tab.
